name: halves
description: Two halves side by side under a title band, with a footer line: before and after, prompt and tasks.

regions.name: title
regions.description: Title band across the canvas (the slide's `title` sugar goes here).

regions.name: left
regions.description: The left half. A single element fills the half's height.

regions.name: right
regions.description: The right half. A single element fills the half's height.

regions.name: footer
regions.description: Footer line across the canvas, typically a source line.

variables.name: --split
variables.description: Column tracks of the two halves, for example `2fr 1fr`.

variables.name: --align
variables.description: Vertical alignment of each half's content: `start`, `center` or `end`. A single element still fills its half; its content moves inside it.
